units.source_text: 后来，我给你去了封电报。

en.t: After that, I sent you a telegram.

units.source_text: 说实在的，那时，我想见你一面，并按照你的希望，把我的过去统统告诉你。

en.t: To tell the truth, at that time I wanted to see you once, and, as you wished, tell you everything about my past.

units.source_text: 你回电说，眼下不能来东京，我很失望，久久地凝视着电报。

en.t: You replied by telegram that you could not come to Tokyo just then, and I was deeply disappointed, staring at the telegram for a long time.

units.source_text: 你似乎也觉得只打电报不妥，随后又给我写来一封长信，所以对于你不能来东京的原因，我已经很清楚了。

en.t: You also seemed to feel that sending only a telegram was not enough, and afterward you wrote me a long letter, so I understood very clearly why you could not come to Tokyo.

units.source_text: 我丝毫不认为你是个失礼的人，你怎么能不顾垂危的父亲，自己离开家呢？

en.t: I did not think for a moment that you were being rude; how could you leave home by yourself, disregarding your father who was near death?

units.source_text: 反倒是我不顾你父亲的生死，要你回京才是欠妥的。

en.t: Rather, it was improper of me to ignore whether your father lived or died and ask you to return to Tokyo.

units.source_text: ——其实我拍那封电报的时候，已经忘记了你父亲。

en.t: In fact, when I sent that telegram, I had already forgotten about your father.

units.source_text: 尽管你在东京的时候，我还一再提醒你，你父亲得的是疑难病症，万不可大意。

en.t: Even though, when you were in Tokyo, I had repeatedly reminded you that your father's illness was difficult and that you must not be careless.

units.source_text: 我就是这样一个矛盾的人！

en.t: That is the kind of contradictory person I am.

units.source_text: 也许是我头脑混乱造成的，但更像是被我的过去压迫成了这样矛盾的人吧。

en.t: Perhaps it was caused by confusion in my mind, but it seems more likely that my past had pressed me into becoming such a contradictory person.

units.source_text: 在这方面，我有着清楚的自省，请你务必原谅我。

en.t: On this point, I have a clear awareness of my own fault, so please forgive me.

units.source_text: 看到你的信——你的最后一封信时，我才发觉自己做了件错事。

en.t: When I saw your letter, your last letter, I realized that I had done something wrong.

units.source_text: 所以，我想回一封信向你道歉，可是拿起笔来，一行没写就放下了。

en.t: So I thought I would write back and apologize to you, but after taking up my pen, I put it down without writing a single line.

units.source_text: 因为倘若我要给你写信的话，就要写这封信，

en.t: Because if I were to write you a letter, it would have to be this letter,

units.source_text: 而写这封信还为时过早，所以就没有写信，

en.t: and it was still too early to write this letter, so I did not write,

units.source_text: 又拍了一封简短的‘不必特意回京’的电报给你。

en.t: and instead sent you another brief telegram saying that you need not make a special trip back to Tokyo.
